dct_description_sm: Stratified sampling uses randomized Link selection

Demo of stratified sampling technique for online CME evaluations. Basic logic and QUestions work. Just crude so far but demonstrates the concept. After the first page, there is a section where the group of questions that you are asked are randomly assigned. There is then a role specific section, which uses an earlier Counter score to determine which questions you will be asked.
